title: Jaipur family protests at police station, alleging hotel death was murder
seoTitle: Jaipur family's protest over hotel death

tea.why: A 32-year-old nursing student was found dead in a Jaipur hotel; police say suicide, the family alleges murder.
tea.want: Arrests, a thorough investigation and compensation.
tea.changed: Oct 2: the family blocked traffic outside Bajaj Nagar police station; the station's SHO was transferred the same day.

summary: Relatives of a 32-year-old nursing student who was found dead in a hotel near Gandhi Nagar railway station in Jaipur on September 30 protested for a second day on October 2 outside Bajaj Nagar police station, blocking traffic. Police say a suicide note was found; the family alleges he was killed and an FIR filed by his brother accuses people who allegedly owed him money. The family is demanding arrests, a thorough investigation and compensation. The city police commissioner transferred the Bajaj Nagar station house officer the same day, citing administrative reasons including performance.
demands: Arrest of those accused in the family's FIR
response: Police maintain the death was a suicide, citing a note; an FIR has been registered on the brother's complaint, and the local SHO was transferred on administrative grounds.

updates.text: The man was found dead in a hotel near Gandhi Nagar railway station.
The family protested for a second day outside Bajaj Nagar police station; the SHO was transferred.
